div.div: POST /api/deeds {method: qr_scan, scan_id}: read the scan's doer (no lock); take reporter_month: under 150 this month (else 429 monthly_report_limit) and under 15 about this doer (else 429 pair_monthly_limit), D19; then consume the scan once (conditional UPDATE) within 15 min; occurred_at ≤ 2 h before the scan; content checked against config

New link: POST /api/invites/{id}/reissue

div.div: PRD section 5: an invite-verified deed earns points (M4) but counts for prize rank only after a second independent report of the same act (built in M2) or human review (M5). All limits on this page come from the deeds config namespace (v4). The monthly limits count every deeds row the reporter created that IST month, whatever its status, so withdrawing frees nothing. The invite expiry job keeps running while invites are off.
